questions.title: Two-Integer Arithmetic Drill
questions.description:
Read two positive integers from stdin and print five arithmetic results, one per line: sum, difference (first minus second), product, integer quotient, and remainder.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers a and b on one line.

Output Format:
Five lines: a+b, a-b, a*b, a/b (integer), a%b.

Constraints:
1 <= a, b <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
a, b = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
puts a + b
puts a - b
puts a * b
puts a / b
puts a % b

questions.title: Maximum of Two Integers
questions.description:
Read two integers and print the larger one using a comparison operator.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers a and b.

Output Format:
Single line: the larger integer.

Constraints:
-1000 <= a, b <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
a, b = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
puts a > b ? a : b

questions.title: Three-Flag Logical Check
questions.description:
Read three integer flags (0 or 1) and convert each to a boolean. Print the AND of all three and the OR of all three on separate lines.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers (0 or 1).

Output Format:
Two lines: "AND: <bool>" and "OR: <bool>".

Constraints:
Each input is 0 or 1.

questions.title: Bitwise Drill on Two Bytes
questions.description:
Read two integers and print four bitwise results, one per line: a&b, a|b, a^b, and a shifted left by 2.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers a and b.

Output Format:
Four lines: a&b, a|b, a^b, a<<2.

Constraints:
0 <= a, b <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
a, b = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
puts a & b
puts a | b
puts a ^ b
puts a << 2

questions.title: Compound Assignment Cascade
questions.description:
Read a single integer n and apply compound assignment operators in sequence, printing the result after each step. Operations: += 5, -= 3, *= 2, /= 4, %= 7.

Input Format:
One integer n on a line.

Output Format:
Five lines, the value of n after each compound assignment.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
n += 5
puts n
n -= 3
puts n
n *= 2
puts n
n /= 4
puts n
n %= 7
puts n

questions.title: Range Bounds Checker
questions.description:
Read three integers lo, hi, x and print "inside" if x falls within the inclusive range lo..hi, otherwise "outside". Use the range operator and case-equality.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers lo hi x.

Output Format:
Single line: "inside" or "outside".

Constraints:
0 <= lo <= hi <= 1000, 0 <= x <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
lo, hi, x = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
puts (lo..hi) === x ? "inside" : "outside"

questions.title: Bakery Bill with Sales Tax
questions.description:
A bakery charges `price` dollars per loaf. A customer buys `qty` loaves, and the city applies `tax` percent sales tax. Compute the grand total.

Input Format:
Three space-separated values: price (float), qty (int), tax (int percent).

Output Format:
Single line: grand total formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 < price <= 1000, 1 <= qty <= 1000, 0 <= tax <= 30
questions.sourcecode:
price, qty, tax = gets.split
price = price.to_f
qty = qty.to_i
tax = tax.to_f
total = price * qty
grand = total * (1 + tax / 100.0)
puts "%.2f" % grand

questions.title: Library Late Fee Capped
questions.description:
A library charges 0.50 per day overdue plus a flat 2.00 processing fee, but the total fine is capped at 20.00. Read days_overdue and print the fine.

Input Format:
One integer days_overdue.

Output Format:
Single line: fine formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= days_overdue <= 365
questions.sourcecode:
days = gets.to_i
fee = days * 0.50 + 2.0
fee = fee > 20.0 ? 20.0 : fee
puts "%.2f" % fee

questions.title: Permission Flag Checker
questions.description:
A file system uses bitmask permissions where read=4, write=2, execute=1. Read a permission mask and a required permission, then print "granted" if the mask has every bit in required set, else "denied".

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers mask and required.

Output Format:
Single line: "granted" or "denied".

Constraints:
0 <= mask, required <= 7
questions.sourcecode:
mask, req = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
puts (mask & req) == req ? "granted" : "denied"

questions.title: Score-to-Grade Mapper
questions.description:
Map a numeric score to a letter grade using the range operator and ternary chains: 90..100 = A, 80..89 = B, 70..79 = C, 60..69 = D, otherwise F.

Input Format:
One integer score.

Output Format:
Single line: the grade letter.

Constraints:
0 <= score <= 100
questions.sourcecode:
score = gets.to_i
grade = (90..100) === score ? "A" :
        (80..89) === score ? "B" :
        (70..79) === score ? "C" :
        (60..69) === score ? "D" : "F"
puts grade

questions.title: Pizza Party Slicer
questions.description:
A pizza party has `pizzas` pizzas, each with `slices_per` slices, shared by `people` guests. Compute how many whole slices each guest receives (integer division) and how many slices are left over.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers pizzas slices_per people.

Output Format:
Single line: two integers separated by a space: slices_per_guest and leftover.

Constraints:
1 <= pizzas, slices_per, people <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
pizzas, slices_per, people = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
total = pizzas * slices_per
per_person = total / people
left = total % people
puts "#{per_person} #{left}"

questions.title: Three-Number Sort by Spaceship
questions.description:
Read three integers and print them in ascending order, one per line, using the spaceship operator <=> for comparisons and arithmetic to recover the middle value.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers.

Output Format:
Three lines: smallest, middle, largest.

Constraints:
-1000 <= each <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
a, b, c = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
small = (a <=> b) <= 0 && (a <=> c) <= 0 ? a : ((b <=> c) <= 0 ? b : c)
large = (a <=> b) >= 0 && (a <=> c) >= 0 ? a : ((b <=> c) >= 0 ? b : c)
mid = a + b + c - small - large
puts small
puts mid
puts large

questions.title: Subnet Mask Equality
questions.description:
Two hosts are on the same subnet if their IP octets AND'd with a mask produce equal network portions. Read octet_a, octet_b, and mask, then print "yes" if the hosts share a subnet, otherwise "no".

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers a b mask.

Output Format:
Single line: "yes" or "no".

Constraints:
0 <= a, b, mask <= 255
questions.blacklist: to_s, ip, class, case, when, if
questions.sourcecode:
a, b, m = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
na = a & m
nb = b & m
puts na == nb ? "yes" : "no"

questions.title: Toll Plaza Discount Multiplier
questions.description:
A toll plaza applies discounts multiplicatively: carpoolers pay 50%, electric vehicles pay 70%, and peak hours add a 25% surcharge. Read carpool_flag, electric_flag, peak_flag, and base_toll, then print the final toll.

Input Format:
Four space-separated integers: cp ev pk base (each flag is 0 or 1; base is the toll).

Output Format:
Single line: final toll formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
base in 1..1000, each flag is 0 or 1
questions.blacklist: if, unless, case, when, while, until
questions.sourcecode:
cp, ev, pk, base = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
factor = 1.0
factor *= cp == 1 ? 0.5 : 1.0
factor *= ev == 1 ? 0.7 : 1.0
factor *= pk == 1 ? 1.25 : 1.0
puts "%.2f" % (base * factor)

questions.title: Pagination Range Builder
questions.description:
A paginated list shows `size` items per page. Given the total item count, page size, and 1-indexed page number, compute the inclusive range string (e.g., "1..10") of indices displayed on that page, clamped at the total.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers total size page.

Output Format:
Single line: "start..end".

Constraints:
1 <= total, size <= 10000, 1 <= page <= ceil(total / size)
questions.sourcecode:
total, size, page = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
start_idx = (page - 1) * size + 1
end_idx = start_idx + size - 1
end_idx = end_idx > total ? total : end_idx
puts "#{start_idx}..#{end_idx}"

questions.title: Compound Expression Precedence
questions.description:
Read four integers a, b, c, d and evaluate the boolean expression (a + b) * c < d && a != b || c == d using Ruby's native operator precedence. Print the result.

Input Format:
Four space-separated integers a b c d.

Output Format:
Single line: "true" or "false".

Constraints:
-1000 <= a, b, c, d <= 1000
questions.blacklist: eval, send, define_method, if, unless, case, when
questions.sourcecode:
a, b, c, d = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
result = (a + b) * c < d && a != b || c == d
puts result

questions.title: RGB Color Blender with Clamping
questions.description:
Blend two RGB colors using alpha (0..100) as a percentage of the second color. Each blended channel is clamped to the legal range 0..255. Print all three channels formatted to two decimals, space-separated.

Input Format:
Seven space-separated integers: r1 g1 b1 r2 g2 b2 alpha.

Output Format:
Single line: "r g b" each formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= each color <= 255, 0 <= alpha <= 100
questions.blacklist: clamp, min, max, each, class, lambda, proc
questions.sourcecode:
r1, g1, b1, r2, g2, b2, alpha = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
a = alpha / 100.0
nr = (1 - a) * r1 + a * r2
ng = (1 - a) * g1 + a * g2
nb = (1 - a) * b1 + a * b2
nr = nr < 0 ? 0 : (nr > 255 ? 255 : nr)
ng = ng < 0 ? 0 : (ng > 255 ? 255 : ng)
nb = nb < 0 ? 0 : (nb > 255 ? 255 : nb)
puts "%.2f %.2f %.2f" % [nr, ng, nb]

questions.title: Tiebreaker Leaderboard
questions.description:
Three players each submit a (id, score) entry. The winner is the player with the highest score; ties are broken by the smallest id. Determine the winner using the spaceship operator and logical operators only.

Input Format:
Three lines, each with two space-separated integers: id and score.

Output Format:
Single line: the winning player id.

Constraints:
1 <= id <= 1000, 0 <= score <= 1000
questions.blacklist: sort, .max, .min, each, times, while, until, for, if, unless, case, when
questions.sourcecode:
a = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
b = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
c = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
winner = (b[1] <=> a[1]) > 0 ? b : ((b[1] <=> a[1]) == 0 && b[0] < a[0] ? b : a)
winner = (c[1] <=> winner[1]) > 0 ? c : ((c[1] <=> winner[1]) == 0 && c[0] < winner[0] ? c : winner)
puts winner[0]

questions.title: Fiscal Calendar Quarter and Peak
questions.description:
Given a month (1..12) and day, compute the calendar quarter (1..4), fiscal half ("H1" for months 1..6, "H2" otherwise), and whether the month is in peak season (months 6..8 or month 12). Use the range operator and case-equality only.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers month day.

Output Format:
Single line: "Qx Hx peak|off".

Constraints:
1 <= month <= 12, 1 <= day <= 31
questions.blacklist: case, when, if, elsif, else, unless, between?, cover?
questions.sourcecode:
month, day = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
quarter = (1..3) === month ? 1 :
           (4..6) === month ? 2 :
           (7..9) === month ? 3 : 4
half = (1..6) === month ? "H1" : "H2"
peak = ((6..8) === month || month == 12) ? "peak" : "off"
puts "Q#{quarter} #{half} #{peak}"

questions.title: Compound Interest with Premium Fee
questions.description:
A bank computes compound interest annually: final = principal * (1 + rate/100) ** years. A fee of fee_pct percent of the final amount is charged; premium customers pay half the fee. Print the net amount.

Input Format:
Five space-separated integers: principal rate years fee_pct premium (premium is 0 or 1).

Output Format:
Single line: net amount formatted to two decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= principal <= 1000000, 1 <= rate <= 30, 1 <= years <= 30, 0 <= fee_pct <= 10, premium in {0, 1}
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= principal <= 1000000, 1 <= rate <= 30, 1 <= years <= 30, 0 <= fee_pct <= 10, premium in {0,1}
questions.blacklist: eval, class, Math, pow, if, case, when, each, times
questions.sourcecode:
principal, rate, years, fee_pct, premium = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
final = principal * (1 + rate / 100.0) ** years
fee = final * fee_pct / 100.0
fee = premium == 1 ? fee / 2.0 : fee
net = final - fee
puts "%.2f" % net
